UAT-RUNNER/WF-05 instruction text matches the real current TBD text verbatim; proposed contrast against Letflow.Simulation.Runner verified accurate (scenario.ex's step()/precondition() typespecs genuinely carry machine-executable params/args maps). DEFERRED_TO_S8 confirmed as a real already-recorded disposition in stage-7-simulation-uat-parity.md, not fabricated. Security flag on 2 platform/ cross-tenant-probe files reasonable, correctly non-blocking. Header/provenance format consistent with real ISS-0388-era precedent (swiftroute/company.yaml:1-4). No disguised executable code (grep clean). No TBD language, no unverifiable citations found. Design is unambiguous and complete enough to hand to ELIXIR-DEV as-is.
